label: ALLOCATION — NO EDGE CLAIMED; NOT DSR-GATED

decision.quote: keep the 7% reserve and record a fresh costed trial. Don’t adopt B-BH as recorded
decision.budget_decision: Requested LIVE budget $200 requires a separate protected review; no execution changes here.

weights: 0.93/k on sleeves with a close at the monthly decision; otherwise zero; no warm-up or vol scaling
rebalance: first observed session of a new month, excluding unknown opener on first panel row; next-session open fills, hold shares between decisions
cash: 7% pre-cost target at rebalance, not a daily floor; no interest

config.source: EDGE: Ardia, Guidotti & Kroencke (2024) JFE 161 103916, Eqs. (23)-(25) p. 6; impact: Toth et al. (2011) Phys. Rev. X 1 021006
config.estimator_version: EDGE per bidask 2.1.0 reference algorithm (return de-meaning included)
config.sigma_convention: daily close-to-close log returns, 21 returns from the 22 closes t-21..t, sample std ddof=1, not annualized
config.volume_convention: mean share volume over sessions t-20..t; volume_basis nominal_reconstructed or provider_nominal only; a split in t-20..t refuses
config.window_policy: 21 NYSE sessions trailing through cutoff t for a t+1 fill (sigma adds close t-21); holidays are not sessions; a missing session refuses
config.spread_handling: S is the full relative spread, charged S/2 per fill; negative S^2 -> sqrt(|S^2|); undefined S refuses
config.warmup_policy: refuse until 22 sessions through t exist; never zero, shortened or stale
config.liquidation_cost_policy: terminal close-out uses the preceding-session estimate

baselines.rule: equal weight of sleeves with close, same monthly decisions; freshly evaluated
sleeves long/flat at 1/2 per monthly decision; equal-weighted; cadence matched, exact turnover not matched

statistics: PSR at own family N=1; no DSR pass or edge claimed; single in-sample pass, no fitted parameters; CV folds/purge/embargo not applicable
voiding: No tuning, no auto retry; one candidate start including errors. Changing the frozen rule needs another spec and declaration.
